area: Live site and the cold run (before submitting)

cases.title: Production mode on the public address
preconditions: On the host: git pull, then cd frontend && uv run npm run build
Backend started WITHOUT --reload: uv run uvicorn app.api:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
Router forwards port 80 to this machine's port 8000
steps: On a phone using mobile data (not home Wi-Fi), open the public address
expected: The sign-in page loads from outside the home network

cases.title: Data survives a restart
preconditions: At least one document uploaded on the live site
steps: Stop the backend (Ctrl+C) and start it again with the same command
expected: The account still signs in and the document is still listed

cases.title: Full journey on the live site
steps: Run AI-01, REV-01, REV-03, SEND-04, SIGN-02, SIGN-04 and SIGN-08 against the public address
Or run the automated check: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.venv/playwright-browsers uv run python backend/scripts/e2e_journey.py <public address> <nda pdf> <output folder>
expected: The downloaded signed PDF is correct
cases.notes: The automated check creates the account tester@example.test; delete its test document from the Inbox afterwards if you want a clean live site.

cases.title: Someone else uses it cold
preconditions: A person who has never seen DockMaster
They bring 2–3 PDFs we have never seen
steps: Give them only the public address
Ask them to sign up, upload one of their PDFs, send it to themselves and one other address they control, and sign both parts
Say nothing while they work; note every hesitation, wrong click or question
expected: They finish upload, review, send, sign and download without help
Every AI mistake they hit was either in Needs review or quick to fix
Each problem found is fixed or logged in DECISIONS.md before submitting
